en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad cobblestone avenue lined with ornate 19th‑century buildings. A large corner building dominated by an advertising sign reading "HUNTER WHISKY" overlooks a busy square with pedestrians, horse‑drawn vehicles and early motor traffic. In the right foreground stands a richly decorated small pavilion or kiosk. The signage on the façades appears in a Central‑European language using the Latin alphabet.
